title: Decode a transported capture
responsibility: Decodes transported artifact bytes and checks the supplied length and hash.

inputs.name: binaryArtifact.value
inputs.description: A transported binary answer with base64 data, encoding, byte length, hash and a string media type.

outputs.name: binaryArtifact
outputs.description: A promise for decoded bytes with the supplied media type and hash after the transport checks pass. The media label is retained, not independently inferred from the bytes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a non-string media type, unsupported encoding or unreadable base64, and bytes whose length or SHA-256 differs from the supplied values.
